name: Companion Atlas
short_desc: Turn your located memories into a shareable 4D (3D + time) scrapbook map.
description: Companion Atlas is a CesiumJS + WebXR globe viewer and MCP processing server that turns geotagged photos and videos from Companion Memory into shareable 4D storytelling maps — created by hand or automatically by an agent.
author: Companion Intelligence

intents.name: atlas.create-story
intents.title: Create a 4D story
intents.description: Build a shareable 4D scrapbook map from the user's located memories in a time/area.
phrases: make a map of my trip
build a 4D story of last weekend

intents.name: atlas.publish-story
intents.title: Publish a story
intents.description: Publish a story and return a shareable viewer link, saving it back to memory.
